description: Save one of your files (an upload, a decomposed assembly's part, a converted model) to this computer and return its path, to open in your CAD tool. Needs an API key.

save_to.description: A folder on this computer to save the file in (default: CLIFF_MCP_DOWNLOADS, else ~/Downloads/Cliff). Set save_to to an empty string to only get the link.

name: download_file
